sample_output.ask: When was MCP announced and who are the named authors?
sample_output.tldr: Found. Anthropic announced MCP on Nov 25, 2024. Named authors: David Soria Parra and Justin Spahr-Summers. Page describes open-sourcing MCP as a standard for connecting AI assistants to systems where data lives.

body.paraphrase: Anthropic open-sourced the Model Context Protocol as an open standard for connecting AI assistants to the systems where data lives.
